new_policy_records.title: Data-center air and water permit pause
new_policy_records.summary: Governor Kotek asked DEQ to use existing authority to pause processing and issuance of air and water-discharge permit applications involving new or expanded data centers until July 1, 2027. The direction includes municipal wastewater permit renewals or modifications needed to accept data-center discharge.
new_policy_records.verification: Primary Governor letter reviewed November 16, 2026; document hosted by OPB.
new_policy_records.notes: Applies to specified DEQ permits, not an independently established blanket construction ban. Letter states no MW threshold. Agency implementation and potential subsequent modification need ongoing monitoring.
